cap: Girls start with thelarche and reach menarche about 2 to 3 years later, with the growth spurt early in puberty. Boys start with testicular enlargement to 4 mL, and their growth spurt comes late, about two years after girls. Bars show typical ages; the order matters more than the exact age.
teach: Peak height velocity comes near breast stage 3 in girls and at genital stage 3 to 4 in boys. Spermarche, the first ejaculation containing sperm, comes in mid-puberty. Pubertal gynecomastia, seen in about half of boys, begins at genital stage 3 to 4 and fades within a year or two.
